segments.text: Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel, for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky;
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: yes, the fish of the sea also die.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night;
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: and I will destroy your mother.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: and will repay them for their deeds.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase;
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: because they have abandoned listening to Yahweh.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: My people consult with their wooden idol,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes;
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend;
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text:
and don’t come to Gilgal,
neither go up to Beth Aven,
nor swear, ‘As Yahweh lives.’
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will Yahweh feed them like a lamb in a meadow?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
segments.speaker: Yahweh
